rows: - 20 Nov, model gateway Headroom stage left off (issue #83 G2; test type: unit-level flow tests against an authored fake sidecar, n=1; no model, no real sidecar, no tokens measured). The stage shortens only the newest message of a request, through a `Compressor` port, and the tests pin that every byte before that message (`system`, `tools`, earlier messages) and after it reaches the provider unchanged, so the prompt cache keeps its prefix; a failing sidecar or a non-matching rule sends the body as it came. Decision: it ships off (`GatewayParts::headroom` is `None` in `main`), because the plan's bar (a net saving of at least 15 % after the cache loss over five recorded sessions) has no measurement yet and no sidecar adapter exists. The saving is not claimed here.
